title: FIGARCH-MF(VIX) — Does long memory add value beyond VIX?

FIGARCH(1,d,1).note: long memory confirmed (d≈0.5-0.6) but no OOS improvement

MF-GJR(VIX).note: BEST MODEL — VIX multiplicative factor significantly improves QLIKE

FIGARCH-MF(VIX).QLIKE: NUMERICALLY UNSTABLE (2601.74 — forecasts explode in OOS)
FIGARCH-MF(VIX).note: FIGARCH lambda coefficients applied to VIX-normalized returns cause OOS divergence. The long memory filter amplifies small mismatches between tau (VIX-driven) and actual returns, leading to explosive g_t forecasts. This numerical instability is itself a result: FIGARCH + MF structure is not robust for OOS forecasting.

GARCH(1,1) vs GJR(1,1,1).interpretation: GJR not significantly better than GARCH

GARCH(1,1) vs FIGARCH(1,d,1).interpretation: FIGARCH no better than GARCH (despite d≈0.5 long memory)

GJR(1,1,1) vs MF-GJR(VIX).interpretation: MF-GJR(VIX) better but not at Harvey threshold

MF-GJR(VIX) vs FIGARCH-MF(VIX).interpretation: Key test: FIGARCH-MF NOT better — numerically unstable. Even ignoring instability, adding long memory to MF structure provides no benefit.

key_comparison.decision: FAIL TO REJECT H0. FIGARCH-MF(VIX) is numerically unstable in OOS and cannot improve upon MF-GJR(VIX). VIX already captures the long-run persistence that FIGARCH attempts to model. The VIX index, being a forward-looking implied volatility measure, inherently incorporates long memory in volatility through options market expectations.

conclusions: 1. MF-GJR(VIX) is the best model: QLIKE = 1.502, +5.37% vs GARCH baseline, DM t = 4.20 (***)
2. FIGARCH(1,d,1) alone does NOT beat GARCH OOS despite confirmed long memory (d≈0.5-0.6)
3. FIGARCH-MF(VIX) is numerically unstable: FIGARCH lambda coefficients + MF normalization cause OOS divergence
4. VIX subsumes long memory: the forward-looking implied vol already captures persistent volatility dynamics
5. Confirms K889: MF-GJR(VIX) remains the best volatility forecasting model for SPY
6. Confirms K442: FIGARCH long memory exists (d≈0.6) but does not improve OOS forecasts
limitations: FIGARCH-MF numerical instability may be implementation-specific; other MF-FIGARCH formulations might be more stable
Only SPY tested; long memory might have incremental value for assets with less liquid options (poor VIX proxy)
Custom MLE implementation for MF models; results should be cross-validated with established packages
Refit every 21 days (not daily) for computational efficiency; daily refit might differ slightly
